posting.fund.funds_off.en: Funds are turned off, so a journal line can't carry a fund. Remove the fund from the line, or turn funds on in Accounting settings.

posting.fund.unknown.en: Fund {fund} doesn't exist. Choose one of the company's funds.

posting.fund.archived.en: The fund {fund} is archived and takes no new postings. Unarchive it first, or choose another fund.

posting.fund.unbalanced.en: The lines of {fund} don't balance: they are off by {difference} {currency}. Each fund's debits must equal its credits.

posting.fund.restricted_net_assets_needs.en: A line on account {code}, restricted net assets, must carry a restricted fund.

posting.fund.retained_earnings_restricte.en: A line on account {code}, retained earnings, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Restricted money is recorded on restricted net assets.

fund.not_enabled.en: Funds are turned off. Turn them on in Accounting settings before adding a fund.

fund.not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this fund. It may belong to another company.

fund.name_taken.en: There is already a fund named {name}. Choose another name.

fund.purpose_required.en: A restricted fund needs a purpose: what the money may be spent on.

fund.restriction_locked.en: {fund} already has postings, so whether it is restricted and its purpose can't change. Create a new fund and move the money to it instead.

fund.balance_held.en: These funds still hold balances: {funds}. Bring each to zero first.

posting.fund.stock_unrestricted.en: A line on account {code}, which holds stock or its cost, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Stock and its cost are held unrestricted.

posting.fund.movement_outside.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds. Restricted money moves only through Transfer between funds, Release from restriction or Reallocate restricted funds.

posting.fund.movement_needs_user.en: Money of {fund} moves between funds only when a person posts the movement, never by an automatic posting.

posting.fund.movement_permission.en: Moving money of {fund} between funds needs the {permission} permission.

posting.fund.movement_template.en: This movement of {fund} doesn't fit its type. A transfer moves money between unrestricted funds, a release takes restricted money to an unrestricted fund, a reallocation moves it to a restricted fund with the same purpose, and an opening assigns unrestricted balances to funds. Each one only moves balance-sheet accounts between funds.

posting.fund.movement_income_expense.en: Account {code} is an income or expense account. A movement between funds moves balance-sheet accounts only.

posting.fund.movement_exceeds_balance.en: {fund} holds {available} {currency} on account {code}, so it can't give {amount} {currency}.

posting.fund.reallocation_needs_authoriz.en: Reallocating money of {fund} needs a reason and a reference to the donor's written authorization.

posting.fund.opening_restricted_negative.en: This opening would leave the net assets of {fund} below zero. Assign the assets that cover its liabilities in the same opening.

posting.fund.release_backing_missing.en: A release from {fund} must name the purpose spending it pays for: posted expense lines, charged to no fund, that add up to the amount released.

posting.fund.release_backing_charged.en: That spending is already charged to a fund, so it can't back a release from {fund}. Only spending charged to no fund can.

posting.fund.release_backing_used.en: The spending on account {code} has already been released from restriction, so it can't back this release from {fund} as well.

posting.fund.movement_void.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds, so it can't be voided. Reverse it instead.

fund.movement_same_fund.en: Choose two different funds. Money can't move from a fund to itself.

fund.movement_not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this movement between funds, or it isn't posted.

fund.transfer_allocation_total.en: The amounts by fund add up to {allocated} {currency}, but the transfer moves {amount} {currency}. Change them so they add up to the amount transferred.

accounting.close_not_found.en: No close of the fiscal year ending {year_end} is posted, so there is nothing to reverse.

posting.fund.origin_fixed.en: This line came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.document_origin_fixed.en: This document came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.key_not_taken.en: A line carries a field these books do not take: {field}

posting.fund.choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for line {line} with its Fund control

posting.fund.document_choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for this document with its Fund for this document control

posting.fund.choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for line {line}

posting.fund.document_choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for this document

posting.fund.choice_line_unknown.en: This document no longer has that line, so its fund choice was not saved.

posting.fund.choice_local_line.en: Line {line} didn't come from outside, so it has no fund to choose. Set its fund on the line itself.

posting.fund.document_posted.en: This document has posted; use Change fund

posting.fund.inbound_key.en: This record came in with {field}, which these books set themselves now that they use funds. Remove {field} and send it again.

fund.turn_on_outside_keys.en: {count} records carry fund fields sent from outside: {records}. Post them (they post as today while funds are off) or delete them, then turn funds on.

fund.turn_off_choices_held.en: Clear or post the fund choices on {records} first

fund.choices_cleared_lines.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_both.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} and the fund for this document were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_document.en: Amounts changed, so the fund for this document was cleared: choose again

notice.peer_journal_needs_funds.title.en: Journal entry from your accountant waiting for funds

notice.peer_journal_needs_funds.body.en: {memo}, dated {date}, from {firm} has not posted yet: choose a fund for each line in From your accountant, then post it. {firm} has been told it is waiting.

posting.fund.hold_changed.en: Your accountant changed this entry. Review it again, then post it.

fund.payment_allocation_total.en: The amounts by fund add up to {allocated} {currency}, but the payment is {amount} {currency}. Change them so they add up to the payment.

posting.fund.allocation_exceeds_open.en: {fund} has {open} {currency} open on this document, so the payment can't settle {amount} {currency} of it.

posting.fund.choice_needed.en: {record} came from {source}: choose the fund for this document.

posting.fund.note_exceeds_open.en: {fund} has {open} {currency} open on this document, so the credit note can apply at most {applicable} {currency} here.

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.total.en: The total was changed by {source}: choose the fund again

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.lines.en: The lines were changed by {source}: choose the fund again

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.tax.en: The tax was changed by {source}: choose the fund again

posting.fund.inbound_line_key.en: Line {line} came in with {field}, which these books set themselves now that they use funds. Remove {field} and send it again.

posting.fund.file_key.en: The file gives {field}. Choose funds on the import screen, not in the file.

fund.connection_unknown.en: These books have no connection by that name. Open the connection from Settings > Connectors and set its default fund there.

fund.default_stale.en: Someone changed this default fund after you opened it. Try again to see the current one.

posting.fund.choice_empty.en: Choose a fund for this document, for every line from outside, or for at least one line.

posting.fund.import_funds_off.en: Funds are turned off, so this import can't choose them. Turn funds on in Accounting settings, or import without fund choices.

posting.fund.choice_record_unknown.en: {record} isn't in this import. Choose funds only for the records it brings.

posting.fund.import_line_unknown.en: {record} has no line {line}. Choose funds only for lines the file has, by their number.

posting.fund.line_without_choice.en: Line {line} has no fund of its own.

docs_import.fund_title.en: Fund for each document and line

docs_import.fund_hint.en: Choose the fund these documents belong to, or Unrestricted. A line left at -- takes the fund chosen for its document.

fund.waiting.count.en: {count} outside documents waiting for a fund choice

fund.waiting.count_one.en: 1 outside document waiting for a fund choice

sync_accounts.funds_hint.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for each line, then Post. Set all outside lines to fills every line still at --.

fund.defaults_hint.en: Documents and entries from these connections take the default fund when they first arrive and post without waiting for a choice. You can still change a document's fund until it posts.

fund.default_inactive.en: Inactive: {user} can no longer choose funds

fund.default_read_only.en: Only users who can manage funds can change this

fund.default_cleared.en: Default fund for {source} cleared. New documents from it will wait for a fund choice.

posting.fund.change_reason_missing.en: Say why the fund is changing. The reason is kept with the change.

posting.fund.change_not_outside.en: Change fund is only for records that came from outside. Use the document void or the journal reverse.

posting.fund.change_not_posted.en: This record has not posted yet. Choose its fund before it posts.

posting.fund.change_settled.en: A payment or note is recorded against this document. Void it, change the fund, then record it again.

posting.fund.change_opening_held.en: The opening balances hold {document}: reverse its opening balance and enter it again with the fund.

posting.fund.change_backing.en: Release {release} is backed by this entry: reverse the release first.

posting.fund.change_needs_reallocation.en: Moving money of {fund} to {to} needs the Reallocate restricted funds permission and the same purpose on both funds.

posting.fund.change_exceeds_balance.en: {fund} holds {available} {currency}; this change would take {amount} {currency} out of it.

posting.fund.change_stale.en: Someone changed this record after you opened it. Try again to see it as it is now.

funds.help.en: Track money by fund. A restricted fund holds gifts a donor limited to a purpose; an unrestricted fund holds money set aside for a use of your own. Lines with no fund post as unrestricted.

funds.off_help.en: Funds are off. Turn them on to give lines on invoices, bills, bank lines and journal entries a fund.

funds.on_help.en: Funds are on. You can turn them off again once every fund is back to zero.

funds.turned_on.en: Funds are on. Add your first fund below.

funds.empty.en: No funds yet. Everything posts as unrestricted until you add one.

funds.restricted_check.en: Restricted: a donor limited what this money may be spent on

funds.purpose_hint.en: What the money may be spent on

funds.archived.en: {name} archived. It takes no new postings until you unarchive it.

funds.move_help.en: Each movement posts its own journal entry with the reason you give. To undo one, reverse it in Fund activity.

funds.transfer_help.en: Move money between two unrestricted funds, or between a fund and money with no fund.

funds.release_help.en: Move restricted money to an unrestricted fund once it has been spent on its purpose. The release names the spending it pays for.

funds.reallocate_help.en: Move restricted money to another restricted fund with the same purpose, when the donor has agreed in writing.

funds.opening_help.en: Give part of an account's balance to a fund when you start using funds. Each line takes the amount from money with no fund.

funds.release_spending_help.en: Tick the spending this release pays for. The release is the total of the amounts ticked.

funds.release_spending_empty.en: No spending is waiting for a release. Post the purpose spending with no fund first, then release it here.

fixed_assets.err_line_other_fund.en: This line is on {line_fund} and {number} is on {asset_fund}. An asset keeps the fund it was bought on, so use a line on {asset_fund}.

fixed_assets.err_change_fund_splits_asse.en: {number} was bought on lines that would end up on different funds ({funds}). An asset keeps one fund, so choose the same fund for all of its lines.

fixed_assets.err_change_fund_class_move.en: {number} moved with the account change of {cls} on {date}. Undo that account change, change the fund, then make the account change again.
